<meta charset="utf-8">

============================================================ -->
<style>
  @font-face{font-family:'Outfit';font-style:normal;font-weight:800;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');unicode-range:U+0100-02BA,U+02BD-02C5,U+02C7-02CC,U+02CE-02D7,U+02DD-02FF,U+0304,U+0308,U+0329,U+1D00-1DBF,U+1E00-1E9F,U+1EF2-1EFF,U+2020,U+20A0-20AB,U+20AD-20C0,U+2113,U+2C60-2C7F,U+A720-A7FF}
  @font-face{font-family:'Outfit';font-style:normal;font-weight:800;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');unicode-range:U+0000-00FF,U+0131,U+0152-0153,U+02BB-02BC,U+02C6,U+02DA,U+02DC,U+0304,U+0308,U+0329,U+2000-206F,U+20AC,U+2122,U+2191,U+2193,U+2212,U+2215,U+FEFF,U+FFFD}
  @font-face{font-family:'Satoshi';font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
  @font-face{font-family:'Satoshi';font-style:normal;font-weight:700;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}

  :root{
    --navy:#0f172a;
    --pb-blue:#7aebff;
    --pb-blue-dark:#30a8bd;
    --pb-green:#7affeb;
    --grad-a:#0e7490;
    --grad-b:#0891b2;
    --text-grad-a:#0891b2;
    --text-grad-b:#06b6d4;
    --ink:#374151;
    --muted:#6b7280;
    --soft:#9ca3af;
    --line:#f3f4f6;
    --line2:#e5e7eb;
  }
  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
  body{
    font-family:'Satoshi',-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;
    color:var(--ink);background:#fff;font-size:16px;line-height:1.65;
  }
  h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Outfit','Satoshi',-apple-system,sans-serif;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);letter-spacing:-0.02em}
  .wrap{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
  img{max-width:100%}
  .tgrad{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--text-grad-a),var(--text-grad-b));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
  .eyebrow{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--soft);margin-bottom:14px}
  .eyebrow-hero{
    font-family:ui-monospace,'Cascadia Code',Consolas,monospace;
    font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.01em;text-transform:none;
    color:var(--grad-b);margin-bottom:20px;line-height:1.9;
  }
  .eyebrow-hero .arrow{color:#94a3b8}
  .eyebrow-hero .date{
    color:var(--navy);background:rgba(122,235,255,.3);
    padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .center{text-align:center}
  section{padding:64px 0}
  @media(min-width:900px){section{padding:96px 0}}
  .sec-h{font-size:clamp(27px,6vw,40px);line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.02em;max-width:21em;margin:0 auto}

  /* ---------- HEADER ---------- */
  .hdr{
    position:sticky;top:0;z-index:60;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.86);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .hdr-in{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:56px}
  .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none}
  .brand img{width:30px;height:30px}
  .brand span{font-size:19px;color:#111827;font-weight:400}
  .brand b{font-weight:700}
  .hdr-cta{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
    background:var(--pb-blue-dark);color:#fff;text-decoration:none;
    font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;padding:9px 15px;border-radius:10px;
    transition:box-shadow .2s,transform .2s;white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .hdr-cta:hover{box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(48,168,189,.35);transform:translateY(-1px)}
  .hdr-cta svg{width:15px;height:15px}
  .hdr-cta .long{display:none}
  @media(min-width:560px){.hdr-cta .long{display:inline}.hdr-cta .short{display:none}}

  /* ---------- HERO ---------- */
  .hero{
    position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#eff6ff 0%,#ffffff 55%,#faf5ff 100%);
    padding:48px 0 64px;
  }
  @media(min-width:980px){.hero{padding:72px 0 80px}}
  /* jemná bodová mřížka, typický prvek vývojářských nástrojů */
  .hero::before{
    content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
    background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(15,23,42,.09) 1px,transparent 1px);
    background-size:24px 24px;
    -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 75% 60% at 50% 35%,#000 20%,transparent 78%);
    mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 75% 60% at 50% 35%,#000 20%,transparent 78%);
  }
  .orb{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(70px);pointer-events:none}
  .orb-a{width:380px;height:380px;background:var(--pb-blue);opacity:.14;top:8%;left:12%}
  .orb-b{width:380px;height:380px;background:var(--pb-green);opacity:.12;bottom:4%;right:10%}
  .hero-grid{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;gap:48px}
  @media(min-width:980px){.hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;align-items:center;gap:56px}}
  .hero h1{
    font-size:clamp(34px,8.6vw,52px);
    line-height:1.04;margin:0 0 22px;
  }
  .hero .sub{font-size:clamp(16px,4.2vw,18px);color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7;max-width:32em;margin-bottom:30px}
  .cta{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;
    min-height:56px;padding:16px 32px;width:100%;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--grad-a),var(--grad-b));
    color:#fff;font-family:'Satoshi',sans-serif;font-size:16.5px;font-weight:700;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;
    transition:transform .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease;
  }
  .cta:hover{transform:scale(1.03);box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(6,182,212,.25)}
  .cta svg{width:19px;height:19px;flex:none}
  @media(min-width:640px){.cta{width:auto}}
  .trust{
    display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px 14px;
    margin-top:22px;font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;
    font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);
  }
  .trust svg{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--pb-blue-dark);flex:none;vertical-align:-3px;margin-right:6px}
  .trust .sep{color:#d1d5db}

  /* okno editoru s běžícím agentem */
  .win{
    position:relative;background:#0b1220;border:1px solid #1e293b;
    border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 30px 70px -18px rgba(2,6,23,.45);
    overflow:hidden;
    font-family:ui-monospace,'Cascadia Code',Consolas,monospace;
  }
  .win-bar{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
    background:#0f172a;padding:11px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid #1e293b;
  }
  .win-bar i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;flex:none}
  .win-bar i:nth-child(1){background:#f87171}.win-bar i:nth-child(2){background:#facc15}.win-bar i:nth-child(3){background:#4ade80}
  .win-tab{
    margin-left:10px;font-size:12.5px;color:#e2e8f0;font-weight:700;
    background:#1e293b;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:6px;
  }
  .win-branch{margin-left:auto;font-size:12px;color:#64748b;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
  .win-branch svg{width:12px;height:12px}
  .win-body{padding:18px 18px 16px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;color:#cbd5e1}
  .win-body .ln{opacity:0;animation:lineIn .4s ease forwards;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .win-body .ln:nth-of-type(1){animation-delay:.3s}
  .win-body .ln:nth-of-type(2){animation-delay:1s}
  .win-body .ln:nth-of-type(3){animation-delay:1.7s}
  .win-body .ln:nth-of-type(4){animation-delay:2.3s}
  .win-body .ln:nth-of-type(5){animation-delay:3.6s}
  @keyframes lineIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
  .t-p{color:#7dd3fc}.t-ok{color:#34d399}.t-arr{color:var(--pb-blue)}.t-dim{color:#64748b}
  .t-cursor{display:inline-block;width:7px;height:14px;background:var(--pb-blue);vertical-align:-2px;animation:blink 1s infinite}
  @keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.25}}
  .diff{
    margin:10px 0;border:1px solid #1e293b;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;
    opacity:0;animation:lineIn .5s ease forwards;animation-delay:2.9s;
  }
  .diff-h{background:#111c31;padding:6px 12px;font-size:11.5px;color:#94a3b8;border-bottom:1px solid #1e293b}
  .diff div{padding:2px 12px;font-size:12.5px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .d-add{background:rgba(52,211,153,.09);color:#6ee7b7}
  .d-del{background:rgba(248,113,113,.09);color:#fca5a5}
  .win-status{
    display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px 16px;
    padding:10px 16px;background:#0f172a;border-top:1px solid #1e293b;
    font-size:11.5px;color:#94a3b8;
  }
  .win-status b{color:#34d399;font-weight:700}
  .win-status .pr{margin-left:auto;color:var(--pb-blue)}

  /* ---------- DATOVÝ PRUH ---------- */
  .facts{display:grid;gap:14px;margin:34px 0 6px}
  @media(min-width:760px){.facts{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}}
  .fact{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px 22px}
  .fact b{display:block;font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(26px,7vw,32px);line-height:1;margin-bottom:8px}
  .fact p{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}
  .fact span{display:block;font-size:11.5px;color:#b6bec9;margin-top:8px;letter-spacing:.04em}

  /* ---------- BOLESTI ---------- */
  .pains{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f9fafb 0%,#fff 100%);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
  .pain-grid{display:grid;gap:20px;margin-top:44px}
  @media(min-width:820px){.pain-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
  .pcard{
    background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;
    transition:box-shadow .4s,border-color .4s,transform .4s;
  }
  .pcard:hover{box-shadow:0 20px 40px -18px rgba(15,23,42,.14);border-color:var(--line2);transform:translateY(-2px)}
  .ill{position:relative;height:116px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
  .ill .big{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(15,23,42,.07)}
  .ill .big svg{width:22px;height:22px}
  .ill .fl{position:absolute;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(15,23,42,.06);animation:float 5s ease-in-out infinite}
  .ill .fl svg{width:13px;height:13px}
  .ill .fl.f1{left:18%;top:26%}
  .ill .fl.f2{right:16%;top:18%;animation-delay:1.6s}
  .ill .fl.f3{right:26%;bottom:16%;animation-delay:3.2s}
  @keyframes float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:.85}50%{transform:translateY(-7px);opacity:1}}
  .ill-blue{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#eff6ff,#eef2ff)}
  .ill-orange{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff7ed,#fffbeb)}
  .ill-red{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fef2f2,#fff1f2)}
  .ill-purple{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#faf5ff,#f5f3ff)}
  .c-blue{color:#3b82f6}.c-orange{color:#f97316}.c-red{color:#ef4444}.c-purple{color:#a855f7}
  .pbody{padding:26px}
  .pbody .tt{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;margin-bottom:12px}
  .pbody .tt svg{width:26px;height:26px;flex:none}
  .pbody h3{font-size:18px;line-height:1.3}
  .pbody p{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.65}
  .pbody .cons{margin-top:12px;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted)}
  .fit-grid{display:grid;gap:16px;margin-top:20px}
  @media(min-width:820px){.fit-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
  .fit{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:24px 26px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted)}
  .fit b{display:block;font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);font-size:16px;margin-bottom:7px}
  .fit-yes{border-color:#a5f3fc;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ecfeff,#f0fdfa)}

  /* ---------- CO UVIDÍŠ ---------- */
  .see-grid{display:grid;gap:16px;margin-top:44px}
  @media(min-width:820px){.see-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}}
  .see{
    display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;
    background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:24px 26px;
    transition:box-shadow .4s,transform .4s;
  }
  .see:hover{box-shadow:0 20px 40px -18px rgba(15,23,42,.12);transform:translateY(-2px)}
  .see .ic{
    width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:12px;flex:none;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ecfeff,#eff6ff);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  }
  .see .ic svg{width:21px;height:21px;color:var(--grad-b)}
  .see h3{font-size:16.5px;margin-bottom:5px}
  .see p{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted)}

  /* ---------- LEKTOR ---------- */
  .coach{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f9fafb,#fff)}
  .coach-card{
    background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;
    box-shadow:0 20px 50px -20px rgba(15,23,42,.12);
    padding:28px 22px;display:grid;gap:24px;margin-top:44px;
  }
  @media(min-width:860px){.coach-card{grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;padding:38px;gap:34px}}
  .avatar{
    width:104px;height:104px;border-radius:50%;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ecfeff,#cffafe);
    border:3px solid var(--pb-blue);
    object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;display:block;
  }
  .coach h3{font-size:23px;margin-bottom:6px}
  .coach .role{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);max-width:40em}
  .stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin:24px 0 0}
  .stat{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:14px;padding:16px 8px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(15,23,42,.04)}
  .stat b{display:block;font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(19px,4.6vw,25px)}
  .stat span{font-size:12px;color:var(--soft);line-height:1.35;display:block;margin-top:3px}
  .quotes{margin-top:24px;display:grid;gap:16px}
  .quote{font-size:14.5px;font-style:italic;color:var(--ink);border-left:3px solid var(--pb-blue);padding-left:15px}
  .q-who{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-style:normal;font-size:13px;color:var(--soft);margin-top:8px}
  .q-who img{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;background:#f3f4f6;flex:none}
  .cohost{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-top:24px;padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
  .cohost img{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ecfeff,#cffafe);border:2px solid var(--pb-blue);flex:none}
  .cohost b{display:block;font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);font-size:15.5px}
  .cohost span{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}

  /* ---------- PROGRAM + REGISTRACE (spojená sekce) ---------- */
  .reg-grid{display:grid;gap:36px;margin-top:8px;align-items:start}
  @media(min-width:980px){.reg-grid{grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:44px;margin-top:40px}}
  .reg-side h3{font-size:20px;margin-bottom:22px}
  .reg-head-d{display:none}
  .reg-head-m{margin:6px 0 18px}
  .reg-head-m h2{font-size:clamp(26px,6.4vw,32px)}
  .reg-head-m .when{margin-top:6px}
  @media(min-width:980px){
    .reg-head-d{display:block}
    .reg-head-m{display:none}
  }
  .tl{display:grid}
  .tli{position:relative;padding:0 0 24px 32px}
  .tli::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:7px;top:22px;bottom:2px;width:2px;background:#a5f3fc}
  .tli:last-child::before{display:none}
  .tli::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:4px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:4px solid var(--grad-b)}
  .tli b{display:block;font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);font-size:16.5px;margin-bottom:4px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
  .tli p{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted)}
  .reg-note{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:4px;
    font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);
  }
  .reg-note svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--pb-blue-dark);flex:none}

  /* ---------- FAQ ---------- */
  .faqs{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f9fafb,#fff)}
  .faq{max-width:720px;margin:36px auto 0}
  .faq details{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:10px;padding:0 20px}
  .faq summary{
    list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:14px;
    font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);font-size:16px;
    padding:17px 0;min-height:48px;
  }
  .faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
  .faq summary::after{content:'+';font-size:22px;color:var(--pb-blue-dark);flex:none;transition:transform .2s}
  .faq details[open] summary::after{transform:rotate(45deg)}
  .faq details p{padding:0 0 18px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted);max-width:44em}

  /* ---------- REGISTRACE ---------- */
  .reg{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ecfeff 0%,#fff 60%,#f0fdfa 100%);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
  .reg .when{color:var(--muted);font-size:16px;margin-top:10px}
  .form-card{
    background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:28px 22px;
    max-width:520px;margin:0 auto;
    box-shadow:0 30px 70px -25px rgba(15,23,42,.22);
  }
  @media(min-width:640px){.form-card{padding:36px}}
  @media(min-width:980px){.form-card{margin:0;max-width:none}}
  .hosts{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:20px;padding-bottom:20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .hosts .pics{display:flex;flex:none}
  .hosts img{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ecfeff,#cffafe);border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(15,23,42,.12)}
  .hosts img+img{margin-left:-12px}
  .hosts div b{display:block;font-size:14px;color:var(--navy)}
  .hosts div span{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--soft)}
  .form-card label{display:block;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);margin:0 0 6px}
  .form-card .hint{font-weight:400;color:var(--soft)}
  .form-card input{
    width:100%;font-size:16px;font-family:'Satoshi',sans-serif;color:var(--navy);
    border:1.5px solid var(--line2);border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:16px;
    min-height:52px;background:#f9fafb;outline:none;transition:border .15s,background .15s;
  }
  .form-card input:focus{border-color:var(--grad-b);background:#fff}
  .form-card .cta{width:100%;margin-top:4px}
  .legal{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--soft);margin-top:14px;line-height:1.5}
  .legal a{color:var(--pb-blue-dark)}
  .thanks{text-align:center;padding:18px 4px}
  .thanks .check{font-size:44px;line-height:1;margin-bottom:12px;color:var(--pb-blue-dark)}
  .thanks h3{font-size:22px;margin-bottom:8px}
  .thanks p{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted)}

  /* ---------- FOOTER (jako ptbk.io) ---------- */
  .ftr{background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:56px 0 110px}
  @media(min-width:900px){.ftr{padding:64px 0 48px}}
  .ftr-grid{display:grid;gap:36px;margin-bottom:44px}
  @media(min-width:720px){.ftr-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
  .ftr h4{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;margin-bottom:18px;font-family:'Satoshi',sans-serif}
  .ftr ul{list-style:none}
  .ftr li{margin-bottom:11px}
  .ftr a{color:#9ca3af;text-decoration:none;font-size:14.5px;transition:color .2s}
  .ftr a:hover{color:#fff}
  .ftr-btm{border-top:1px solid #1f2937;padding-top:32px;display:grid;gap:28px}
  @media(min-width:900px){.ftr-btm{grid-template-columns:1fr auto;align-items:center}}
  .ftr-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;margin-bottom:12px}
  .ftr-brand img{width:30px;height:30px;filter:brightness(0) invert(1)}
  .ftr-brand span{font-size:19px;font-weight:700;color:#fff}
  .ftr-copy{font-size:13px;color:#9ca3af;line-height:1.6}
  .ftr-claim{font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:8px}
  .ftr-fund{text-align:left}
  @media(min-width:900px){.ftr-fund{text-align:right}}
  .ftr-fund img{height:72px;width:auto;margin-bottom:10px}
  .ftr-fund p{font-size:11.5px;color:#6b7280;line-height:1.6;max-width:34em}

  /* ---------- STICKY CTA (jen mobil) ---------- */
  .sticky-cta{
    position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:50;
    padding:10px 16px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.93);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
    border-top:1px solid var(--line2);
    transform:translateY(110%);transition:transform .3s ease;
  }
  .sticky-cta.on{transform:none}
  .sticky-cta .cta{width:100%;min-height:52px}
  @media(min-width:900px){.sticky-cta{display:none}}
</style>

<div class="sticky-cta" id="stickyCta">
  <a class="cta" href="#registrace">Rezervovat místo zdarma
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7"/></svg>
  </a>
</div>

<script>
  // Sticky CTA: objeví se po odskrolování hera, schová se u formuláře
  var hero=document.getElementById('top');
  var reg=document.getElementById('registrace');
  var bar=document.getElementById('stickyCta');
  var heroOut=false,regIn=false;
  function updateBar(){bar.classList.toggle('on',heroOut&&!regIn);}
  new IntersectionObserver(function(e){heroOut=!e[0].isIntersecting;updateBar();},{threshold:.15}).observe(hero);
  new IntersectionObserver(function(e){regIn=e[0].isIntersecting;updateBar();},{threshold:.25}).observe(reg);

  // Demo odeslání: v produkci nahradí POST do MailerLite/webhooku
  // a redirect na děkovací stránku, kde se střelí CompleteRegistration.
  document.getElementById('regForm').addEventListener('submit',function(ev){
    ev.preventDefault();
    var n=document.getElementById('f-name'),m=document.getElementById('f-email');
    if(!n.value.trim()||!m.value.trim()||m.value.indexOf('@')<0){
      (!n.value.trim()?n:m).focus();return;
    }
    document.getElementById('formCard').innerHTML=
      '<div class="thanks"><div class="check">✓</div>'+
      '<h3>Máš místo. Uvidíme se 21. 8. v 19:00.</h3>'+
      '<p>Odkaz na připojení ti přišel na e-mail. Zkontroluj i spam a promotions.</p>'+
      '<p style="margin-top:14px;font-size:13px">V produkci: samostatná děkovací stránka /webinar-potvrzeni,<br>tlačítko Přidat do kalendáře a event CompleteRegistration.</p></div>';
  });
</script>
